name: rasik-studio
description: Rasik Studio — an original AI-native IDE (Electron + React + FastAPI)

scripts.migrate: cd apps/backend && uv run python scripts/check_migration_lock.py
scripts.worker: pnpm infra:up && cd apps/backend && uv run celery -A app.core.celery_app worker --loglevel=info --pool=threads --concurrency=4
scripts.start: pnpm infra:up && pnpm migrate && pnpm dev
